summary: Firefox made several improvements to core document and window behavior, including renaming Feature-Policy to Permissions-Policy and adopting the Structured Field Values (SFV) parser used by modern web standards. It also improved referrer-policy parsing, CSS skew transforms, focus navigation through popovers and shadow roots, drag handling, PDF viewer checks, speech-recognition warnings, XML language attributes, and performance for idle callbacks; _most of these changes are behind-the-scenes reliability and standards-compatibility fixes._
